before.title: Brand Positioning
before.body: Caption by Hyatt is Hyatt’s upscale select-service lifestyle brand in the Boundless Collection. It mixes lifestyle design and neighborhood energy with a leaner operating box than Hyatt Centric or Hyatt Regency. Talk Shop is Caption’s signature all-day arrival and F&B hub — coffee shop, workspace, eatery, grab-and-go market, and cocktail bar in one programmed commons. Owners should treat Caption as a commons-led product—not a limited-service Hyatt Place box and not a full-service explorer hotel.

before.title: Guest Psychographics Description
before.body: Caption guests want a hotel that feels of the neighborhood: they work, eat, and linger in Talk Shop rather than treating the lobby as a pass-through. Typical demand mixes leisure, bleisure, and independent business travelers who value digital check-in, mobile ordering, and local programming over banquet depth. If your market’s guests mainly want highway convenience or large group blocks, Caption is usually the wrong Hyatt flag.

before.title: Commercial edge on this brand
before.body: Named social-commons product (Talk Shop) plus World of Hyatt reach—without Centric full-service operating intensity.

after.title: Commercial Differentiator
after.body: Versus Hyatt Place conventional select-service, Caption sells lifestyle-forward select-service; versus Hyatt Centric explorer lifestyle, Caption keeps leaner select-service capital inside World of Hyatt.

before.title: How This Brand Can Lift Your Project
before.body: Caption by Hyatt lifts projects when a genuine Talk Shop social commons creates local and in-house capture inside an upscale select-service box, backed by World of Hyatt distribution. Commercial strengths below are brand-specific mechanisms—not portfolio averages or performance guarantees. Compare to Hyatt Place, Hyatt Centric, and lifestyle peers before treating Caption as interchangeable “Hyatt lifestyle.”
